rag.text:
Test: TC-539 — Global - Holiday plans - Resynchronize with Tempo
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-26 Global - Holiday plans
Labels: be-enterprise

Steps:
1. Navigate to Tempo -> Settings -> Holidays
   Data: _Tempo_ should be installed
   Expected: Holidays tab is displayed
2. Add new Holiday scheme passing this set of data
   Data: name: TC-539 Holiday Plan to edit
description: TC-539 Holiday Plan to edit
   Expected: Holiday plan is added
3. Click Configure option next to holidayPlanName
   Data: holidayPlanName: TC-539 Holiday Plan to edit
   Expected: Configuration page is displayed
4. Add new fixedHoliday and floatingHoliday passing this set of data
   Data: fixedHoliday: Fixed 1
duration: 1d
date: 01/Oct/20



name: Floating 1
duration: 1d
date: 08/Oct/20
   Expected: Floating  and Fixed Holidays are added
5. Navigate to BP Administration -> Holiday plans tab and click Synchronize with Tempo button
   Expected: "TC-539 Holiday Plan to edit" is displayed on the list with green Tempo lozenge.
6. Click on holidayPlanName
   Data: holidayPlanName: TC-539 Holiday Plan to edit
   Expected: Details page of TC-539 Holiday Plan to edit is displayed

"Fixed 1" holiday is displayed on Calendar on 01/Oct

"Floating 1" holiday is displayed on Calendar on 08/Oct/20
7. Navigate back to Holiday plan list and click on Edit button next to holidayPlan and set newName and description
   Data: workloadPlan: TC-539 Holiday Plan to edit
newName: TC-539 Holiday Plan edited on BP level
   Expected: Changes are saved.

Holiday plan synchronized from Tempo is overwritten in BP level. Blue pencil icon is displayed next to holiday plan name.
8. Navigate to Tempo -> Settings -> Holidays
   Expected: Holidays tab is displayed

"TC-539 Holiday Plan to edit" is still displayed on the list. Changes made in BP level are not visible in Tempo.
9. Click on name of holidayScheme and set newName
   Data: holidayScheme: TC-539 Holiday Plan to edit
newName: TC-539 Holiday Plan resynchronized
   Expected: Changes are saved
10. Navigate to BP Administration -> Holiday plans tab
   Expected: Holiday plans tab is displayed

"TC-539 Holiday Plan edited on BP level" is still displayed on the list
11. Click on holidayName to open details page
   Data: holidayName: TC-539 Holiday Plan edited on BP level
   Expected: Holiday details page is displayed. 

Additional "Resynchronize with Tempo" button is displayed in right header
12. Click on Resynchronize with Tempo button
   Expected: Holiday plan is resynchronized. 

Holiday plan name "TC-539 Holiday Plan resynchronized" is displayed in left header.
13. Go back to Holiday plans tab and check visibility after refresh
   Expected: "TC-539 Holiday Plan resynchronized" is displayed on the list with green Tempo lozenge
